evidences.evidence_quote: RF signals, including WiFi [23], UHF RFID [24, 41, 25, 26], UWB [27], mmWave signals [29, 31, 32, 28, 42, 7], can be considered as a wireless vibrometry to measure the RF signal changes caused by the sound source vibration.
evidences.evidence_context: i). RF-based SSEA. RF signals, including WiFi [23], UHF RFID [24, 41, 25, 26], UWB [27], mmWave signals [29, 31, 32, 28, 42, 7], can be considered as a wireless vibrometry to measure the RF signal changes caused by the sound source vibration. There are two different setup for RF-based SSEAs including reflective and emissive attacks.
